before.source: Unchanged base catalog data with only the new regression module added
before.cause: 0 != 1: one explicit model-routes registration must be published
before.scope: Behavioral failure on the absent catalog registration, not an import or fixture error

checks: The real repository build_landscape join admits the exact pending-empty registration and scope sentence.
Removing registration_only refuses an empty verdict with the candidate diagnostic.
Adding a winner, sealed lane run or wave claim refuses the registration with the unrun-state diagnostic.

rules_suites.command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_registration_rules tests.test_pending_catalog_registration tests.test_layer_verdicts tests.test_record_verdicts tests.test_model_routes_registration
rules_suites.execution: Native TestLoader/TextTestRunner, with fixture stdout/stderr captured only for output size

boundary: Fixture mutations are in-memory reads; no published row or frozen evidence is mutated by a test.
No model request, account-state read, provider mutation, install, receipt registration or sweep dispatch occurs.
The separate single-family initial sweeps are later PRIOR evidence, never this registration's verdict or FINAL.
This is registration integrity evidence, not a route capability comparison or E2E adoption result.
